capabilities.name: verify_claim
capabilities.description: Verifies whether a procurement, delivery, schedule, or vendor claim is supported, contradicted, or insufficiently supported by available evidence. Does not determine final blame, update vendor trust, or retrieve historical precedent.

capabilities.name: compare_documents
capabilities.description: Compares two or more procurement documents to detect discrepancies. Does not verify physical progress on site or assess vendor scorecards.

capabilities.name: detect_contradiction
capabilities.description: Performs deep semantic contradiction detection between a verbal/written claim and site logs or other evidence. Does not perform full verification verdict.

capabilities.name: find_missing_evidence
capabilities.description: Identifies missing mandatory proof items required to validate a pay app or delay claim. Does not verify the claim itself.

capabilities.name: verify_progress
capabilities.description: Audits physical installation or offsite manufacturing progress claims against photo/telemetry evidence. Does not audit invoice pricing.

capabilities.name: verify_invoice
capabilities.description: Audits line-item pricing, quantities, and terms against active PO and contract master records. Does not evaluate weather delays.
